text: I came with a party of 15 people for a birthday breakfast at 8:00 a.m. and everything went without issue. We were seated promptly, mostly due to the earliness of our arrival, and they took our drink orders very quickly and got everything sorted out well. Our server Diana and all of her coworkers got our orders in and our food out very promptly and very accurately, and everything was DELICIOUS. Be sure to ask about the specials. This is a breakfast/brunch spot for anyone who's looking for a great meal.

I was looking forward to this place from my sister in law suggestion. However, everything tasted bad  we ordered. I have never had to write a review like this. I ordered the giant cinnamon roll. It was dry and lacks flavor. Then got them to replace it with the avocado toast Which was burnt and taste like lots of butter and full of salt. My husband order chicken and waffles. The waffle was burnt. So was the three others that ordered it.
Website said OPEN.  Drove 30 mins and got there and doors closed and lights out. Posting on door said hours  were open. No "temporary closing ".

My husband and I are in town for a short trip and ordered from here last night. It was very delicious! We had a pepperoni and mushroom pizza, garlic knots, and I also ordered a small Italian style salad. The pizza and knots were 10/10 the salad was pretty good too just lacking seasoning in the dressing. All and all would definitely order from here again, also ordered via grubhub and only took like 40 min!

DELICIOUS. Some of the best food we had in all of Louisiana. Huge portions, good prices, great service. The Mac n cheese with roast beef gravy is to die for. The mixed seafood poboy is also just divine. Eat here!!

Cuatro leches cake!!! Do I really need tp say anymore? Omg. It's like heaven in a cake. Honestly, I've never been a fan of tres leches cake, but this TOTALLY made me fall in love. I have no idea what they put in this bad boy, but I'm willing to seriously drive from the NW side of town to Broadway just to get it. You know what adds to the experience? The service of the staff. Most polite and friendly folks out there. I'm a lifer.
Fresh fabulous and filling ! The very best pizza I've ever had . Great community friend and business that is great to their employees and continues to grow.

So we decided to go back to Don Pancheto since they reopened and I can sit in a restaurant and have a meal. I has the salmon with rice and beans. Tony had a deconstructed chicken fajitas and churro with ice cream for dessert. Fabulous.

Called an order in for delivery 2.8 miles away. An hour and a half goes by and I still got no word, so I called to get a status update. They said it was out in delivery. :15 more minutes goes by, still no pizza in my mouth. Decided to drive to the business to see what the deal was, and they called the delivery driver. He was out on delivery, pulling into the drop spot of the care package. I still beat him there, took a dump, wiped twice, started and finished a game of monopoly. Finally he arrived. He was very polite. Mike, get your shit together.
Hello my email is debid42069@gmail.com, contact me if interested. Contacting my email is the best way to get a hold of me. Thank you

It's a lovely little restaurant with nice murals outside. Lunch counter inside with table seating outside. Servers were friendly. I ordered the Bang Bang Shrimp Bánh mi and egg rolls. The sandwich was awesome!! Shrimp were large and had that sweet and savory flavor without getting too soggy from the sauce. Vegetables were crisp and delicious. The egg rolls were bland. The sauce that accompanied them didn't help at all. Flavors didn't seem to compliment each other much. I'll definitely be back. Bánh mi was delicious. However, I won't be ordering egg rolls.

I was in Philly for a softball tournament and figured I'd introduce my daughter to a cheesesteak. She's a picky eater but the first sound out of her from the first bite of the cheesesteak with onions and whiz was, "hmmm, yum!". I have to say of the ones I've had this was a very flavorful sandwich and their fries are awesome! All the famous places around, Pats, Geno's are all BLAND I n comparison.

I say if you want a tasty cheesesteak you have no choice but to come to this place! You won't be disappointed.

Was thrilled to go back to this place and take my family. The POKE bowl is to die for....super fresh super packed with deliciousness...and so good for you.The staff was so great.... 
Sauces are great
The Pad Thai was fantastic. I wish I had this place near me as it truly is a masterpiece.

Awesome experience! The staff is incredibly accommodating and so friendly. I felt like such a jerk for going in and not realizing they were closing very soon, and they kept the kitchen open and waited on us despite that (close at 9 and we went in at 8:50 thinking they closed at 10). Not only were the servers and staff very very nice and reassuring that it was okay for us to stay, the food is delicious!!  I'm such a picky eater and my chimichanga was perfect. Not too mention they make salsa right in front of you at the table to your specifications and it was also delicious.  The atmosphere is great too.  It was a great experience.  The staff can really make or break a place, and this one made it. I wish I could remember our waiter's name because he was so wonderful.

It's a typical chain restaurant with a lot of bang for your buck.  Not great, but not bad.  Would definitely be better eating in versus taking out/ delivery.  You will leave FULL!

My chief complaint is that they don't toast both sides of their Texas Toast, so it isn't actually crunchy.  This bleeds into their fries- they are 'steakhouse fries' that aren't crispy.  Would prefer the more traditional cut.

Otherwise, the brisket is solid, although it has no smoke rings.

Excellent selection of wines, especially from a few less well-known regions. But I was very disappointed by the lack of caution around Covid. We called ahead and asked the manager, Ashley, about what policies they had in place to keep customers safe, but we found that in practice none of these policies were being followed. Patrons were not seated six or more feet apart inside, and waitstaff mostly wore their masks around their necks or only on their mouths. It felt like they didn't take our safety or the safety of people we came into contact with seriously. Outside, there weren't any fans and it got pretty toasty. On the plus side, the paella was pretty dang good!

The restaurant door was locked idk for the ya reason & they were so unprofessional. They had attitudes when taking my order & said it was an 20 minute wait & me & my friend came back 20 minutes later then they told us come back in 5 minutes. It was just a lot because they had there door locked
Sooooo bomb! In work right across the street from them so I am a frequent buyer. The bowls are amazing and are not too badly priced. Little family run joint, love it!

We had dinner here a couple of weeks ago and the food and service was excellent. The restaurant is a BYOB and located in a part of Lansdale with plenty of off street parking. I tried Pho for the first time and really enjoyed it. Will definitely be coming back.

So glad I didn't pay for the dinner we had. My in-laws had some  comps to eat here.  They did a great job with COVID 19 rules.  They did a horrible job with the food. Way over priced. All the appetizers seemed like frozen bagged items from the food  distributor. The pizza we had was very dry and over cooked. I recommend eating somewhere else before you get to the casino.

Boswells has been one of my favorites in the city as far as Jamaican cuisine goes. Good food and reasonable prices. Today's experience was the worst. FOH did not serve my drinks I had to get cups on my own as if I'm part of staff, the food wasn't hot and the older lady with red hair had the worst attitude towards my table alone as she was wonderful with others dining in. Not once did she check on us,, I had to have my food put in the microwave. That was my last visit. When I spend my money any establishment I expect to be treated a certain way. She blew it for me,,,until she is removed I won't be back.... Customer service need improvement!!!

We went earlier this morning around 11 am.  Took for ever to be seated.  They were severely understaffed.  The poor cashier/front desk/ hostess was running around like a chicken with her head cut off.  The poor girl had to take payments no option to pay at the table, handle the wait list, clean tables and then more.  The menu was very interesting with lots of healthy choices but did not hold a candle to any of the local breakfast places or diners. I had the Chickichanga which was not bad taste wise but wasn't hot.  My wife had the quinoa pancakes that were a tad burnt.  Like the decor, nice location at the Old Binni and Flynn's spot but not sure thats enough to make us return.

When the novelty wears off people will go back to Nudy's, Minella's and Classic Diner.
One of my favorite places in doylestown food and drinks are 5 star! Small romantic quiet.

The food is excellent here. There isn't a long wait and you're for sure you're going to get authentic Caribbean food. 

Please get the pineapple ginger juice!!

I'll never lead you wrong. This is a another fantastic place I found on Yelp.  If you're looking for a big, delicious, affordable sandwich you have to give them a try.  Cash is king here but you won't need much!

The stars are for the battered fish, but not much else would make us return. My friend found the Fettuccini Alfredo to be watery and bland, though he liked the fried ravioli. The sangria tasted too syrupy for my taste, and strangely, when I asked for a baked potato with my fish, the server assumed I wanted it *in addition to* fries. No big deal, I had him take it off the check. The weirdest part, which dropped this review from a three to a two star was when a Lizzo song came on, we watched as a number of women throughout the restaurant, customers and servers alike, danced and sang along -- but then halfway through the song, one of the male employees switched it and suddenly we were listening to Weezer. I watched the women servers complain to the male employee and I wondered what his deal was. Don't eff with Lizzo, even in Franklin, TN.

It's very hard to find them open but we kept trying because we heard good things. It was Tuesday and we wanted family packs. We were told they only serve those on Wednesdays. So we tried to buy meat by the pound. Many options were not available. So then we tried to get plates. When we ordered the rib plate, you get three bones, which is not a lot. The brisket plate also has a small portion of meat. During all of this, they were not helpful in us trying to order for a family and the main guy also seemed annoyed. Once we tried the food, the sides were good bu the meat was all dry. The ribs were overbooked and tough. There are two sauces: one is hit and three other is way too sweet. So the meat needs sauce because it's dry but the sauces are not good. We are not going back.

OK I know in previous reviews... I knocked it down to three stars, since they removed One of my favorite menu items the baked haddock.

But I am happy to report it has been brought back... Obviously you should always check to make sure before you make plans do you have any other menu items... Always check the menu online first.

Hope this helps... Happy eating!

So, the hotel beautiful, but wow, we had to wait 20 minutes just to valet park, for $40/day. Restaurant lines are ridiculous, all to pay 20-30 a plate for so so food and slow service. I don't want to discount the employees, they have all been wonderful and very friendly. They are just over worked and can't appropriately service the bazillion people coming through the hotel. This hotel will also nickel and dime you to death. Literally nothing is free and for the daily room rate you would think you would get some additional benefit, but nope. For kids it's a treat, but I don't think I would return. Also, WiFi is terrible! Absolutely no service.
We've been waiting  30 minutes only to learn they have yet to start putting our 2 cold sandwiches together!
Host was friendly and personable.  Waitress, Barbara, was wonderful and pleasant, very patient with our grandson.   Food was good and restaurant has a happy atmosphere.

I ordered the biscuits with sausage gravy. The sausage was cut up and the gravy didn't have a lot of flavor. We ordered bloody marys. They were good and they were bottomless. Our waitress was Pamela. She was attentive and funny. We didn't want a refill on the Bloody Mary but she was insistent and even gave us to go cups. We enjoyed her. If the line looks long don't fret, it moves quickly.

I really was impressed with the greeting we received when we arrived at Flapjacks. The host was friendly and welcoming.  We were asked for beverages and told that our server would be right with us. Ok, she came to our table without a hello or even making eye contact. I asked how her day was and she told us it was an "off" day. I told her I hoped it got better. She was quite unfriendly and seemed preoccupied with whatever it was causing her "off" day. Sorry lady, it's not about you. 
As far as the rest of the experience, it was great. The atmosphere was locals which we like and the place was orderly despite being being busy. The food was great and believe it or not the waitress finally came around.

My fiancé and I wanted to find a local Thai place that was reasonably priced and not too far from our place. We usually go to SukhoThai but they are pricey although good. We looked on my favorite app Yelp and looked at the photos and prices and decided to give them a try! We drove 6 miles to pick up our order to go. I was pleasantly surprised at the taste and amount of food you get for the prices! They do have better prices and you get your money's worth. The only thing that was wrong that was TOTALLY MY FAULT, was the spice level. I underestimate spice levels pretty often and I did once again with my Veggie PadThai that I ordered. I got a level 3 when I should've gotten a level 1...lol they have strong spice so if you just want a LITTLE KICK, I suggest getting a 1 or a 2. A 3 is going to make your eyes water and nose run like it did to me... lol My fiancé and I had the Veggie Spring Rolls and both were impressed. He got the Beef PadThai and he loved it... we will be back!

So happy to love in a neighborhood that is also home to this great establishment. The coronatimes have changed a few things for all of us, especially restaurants. These guys go above and beyond to keep everyone safe and still deliver amazing food and great drinks-draft beer selection is always on point!

Well, as everyone else, if I read these reviews, I would have gone to In-N-Out.

My burger tasted more like bread and anything else, the fries were fresh but I asked for no salt and there was salt. The onion rings were cold and had a little bit of a chewiness to them. The dining room had papers on the floor and tables. There was only a few people here, so I figure they should have time to clean?

I would've given them a 1 star but the people were friendly and the service was pretty good.

Stopped by today for the first time. 
Hoping they would have something vegan. 
Well the guy working there was super helpful and pointed out a lot of sandwich's and wraps that can be made vegan! 
I got the garbanzo wrap and the veggie sandwich on ciabatta replaced the cheese with hummus and OMG sooooo good 
VEGGIES ALL FRESH!
Deff returning and the staff is super friendly considering they have to work wearing masks. 
Big thanks to the guy working today for helping me out!!!!

Friendly smiles, inviting space and perfectly seasoned Jerk Chicken.  I had the half chicken and the honey chicken bowl and both were incredible.  I will return soon and often for this delicious grub.  Thanks Riddim n' Spice, y'all are doing great things!!!!

My sandwich I received from here was fine.. but I am very disappointed by the service I came in during lunch and there was no line I stood and ordered then the female employee who was about to help me seemed to be in a bad temper then when moving to check out asked if I was dining in or taking out I said for here and I thought she responded with is there anything else so I asked for a water cup and she replied with that didn't answer my question very rudely the rest of our exchange was brief since I was caught off guard by such a rude tone from and employee. Also while checking out she entered my order then just kinda stormed off into the back without even giving me my receipt..

I was able to go back today, and it was quiet (only one worker, and I was the only customer). It was a much better experience overall--i.e., instead of trying to stuff the nachos and chips together in one bowl, the worker separated them--which was helpful in terms of value, but also, I had walked to IV, so by the time I got home, everything would've been soggy if the nachos+stuff weren't separated. So it was an excellent execution ;D

This is the way I remember enjoying Pokeceviche at the Oxnard location (bummer that that one closed)--I finished it all in one sitting, but I was so full and should've actually saved leftovers for later :X. I will continue to come back when I am craving (primarily) my seaweed salad/crab salad nachos hahahah =D thank you Pokeceviche team!

And then there were five!

Over the years, Koko has crept up in our local Korean food preferences. Now that we've had their Cheese Buldak (fire chicken with mozarella on top), they have to get all five stars. So delicious!

We also had the spicy pork with kimchi stirfry and the spicy squid; both were terrific! 

Banchan can be a little bit boring, but always good.

Love, love love Mifflin Tavern!! So glad they started delivery!! Yaaaaaaa!!!! 
Everything is always fresh and delicious.

DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS PLACE. Especially through door dash. Idiots claim they didn't receive our order, but we received another person's order. Called them and the lady we spoke to was flipping clueless.  This place sucks.

We stopped here after we arrived at Boise Airport last evening because it was close and we were really hungry! This pizza is just AMAZING, and took me back to my childhood of growing up in the Detroit suburbs. We had the Detroit pizza but with sausage, mushrooms and olives in addition to the pepperoni. The pizza is caramelized on the edges, the bottom of the crust is crispy, chewy in the middle and the top was caramelized, crunchy. They put sauce on the top--which made it a beautiful site. It was a taste you can't forget! We had it for lunch today and still want it again! We will have to go back, even though it is an hour drive. I'll never come to Boise without stopping here!

This Benihana's is the BEST in the nation. The staff is friendly and welcoming. Ask for Juan as your chef-his show and food cooking finesse is outstanding. 
Atmosphere
Friendly and more open as compared to others.
Even though full tables, not too loud. 
Food
Generous servings of salad and soup. The other group at our table had alot of food allergies but Juan accommodated them all expertly. The fried veggie rice is extra but worth it. My go to preference is the salmon-love the avocado sauce. The noodles are delicious! The other group ordered calamari-reported that it was superb. Note-it is square not rings. 
Service
Unmatched! If you are going for the best experience ever-go here!! ALL of the staff were on-hand to sing and tambourine the birthday song also in Japanese! 
Summary
Only go to this Benihana's for the best dining experience ever. Three cheers to mamagement and staff!

Staff is always very nice here. Got out and got me a strawberry Açaí refresher which was suppppppper delicious and it was based off a recommendation from the staff! Sooo tasty! I needed a little pick me up but didn't want coffee so that was a nice change. This place is always super busy and they have a drive thru which is great! Especially if ya have kids and you need that treat!
This place is consistent. The service is a little slow but the food is always good. I would recommend going here.
It would've been better if I went to the grocery store, purchased ground meat and made my own hamburger. Their food do not match their price.  The bun was stale, just a horrible experience.

Came here at the (re)start of outdoor dining in CA this past weekend. Love the cozy atmosphere they've created on the sidewalk: tables are decently spaced apart--not always 6 feet away--with strong heat lamps next to them. 

Ordered the pasta + meatballs dish which was piping hot and hearty. Wife ordered the pasta with mushrooms which was a bit tepid in temperature but still tasty overall. 

Good wine selection at decent prices.

I really want to like this place because of all the positive reviews but my experience was not that great. The staff was friendly but service is extremely slow, they even forgot to bring the extra side dishes I ordered. The portion is small, meat is tough and not tender, limited selection, and overall just short of mediocre.  

I apologize for the poor comment. Please improve so I can write a better one.

$$$ Good, high end, sashimi, with a bit of different style.  I was a bit surprised at the small size of fish on the $35 sashimi plate, but you are pretty far from any airport with direct flights from Japan.  Shima Aji, Uni from Santa Barbara, nice Toro all available here midweek!  Served with great style, and some different sides than most sushi bars.

NOLA.NAWLIN. NEW ORLEANS what ever way  you say it... this CHICKEN ROCKS! Hot and delicious kinda funky hole in the wall and as always, chicken shacks usually are as good as crack! ( not crack crack cause I have no idea what crack taste like!)

Went here for lunch today and I must say they did a great job of keeping customers as safe as possible. Hand sanitizer was available in the lobby, all employees were wearing masks and tables were 6 feet apart. I also noticed all kitchen staff were wearing masks which was appreciated. Patio seating is available.The food was absolutely delicious, the drinks were strong and service was great! We had the lobster escargot (best dish) to start, I had the scallops and my husband had the meat loaf as our entrees , everything was flavorful and well prepared! Will definitely be returning .
Delicious. Authentic chilaquiles. The requested spicy salsa was perfect and authentic. My husband lived the choke verde. We'll be back!

The worst brunch I've had. And a very unapologetic staff, who left me waiting a long time, only to deliver non satisfactory food. I used to love dinner and sangrias at Casa Tina, but after that, I would not go back.

Here in Plant City Florida is a winery and brewery place worth visiting. Keel and Curley Winery was started in spring of 2003 in the kitchen of founder and owner, Joe Keel.  Keel, a central Florida blueberry farmer, wanted to find something to do with his end of crop blueberries so he decided blueberry wine would be interesting and dabbled with his creation in the family farm house kitchen.  He started that in spring of 2003 with 10 gallons of blueberry wine.  The wine came out okay, but drinkable.  So he made 10 more gallons and it got better each time, until it turned into the unique and charming flavors that Keel & Curley is known for today.

The staff is welcoming and charming. You could sample the different wine flavors or brewery taste of your choice. It also has events year round you can bring with family. Some free others you have to pay. I recommend this place if you're into wine or brewery. It has some interesting facts and history.

Legit good street taco fare. For only 7 to 12$ you can stuff yourself full of this authentic Mexican goodness. My only complaint is that their chicken tacos are too plain and dry.  Their Brabbaco however is mouthwateringly good!  So are their shrimp tacos.

This was our first time ordering here because our usual place is closed.  They accidentally gave our very large order to someone else.  Then our replacement order was crammed into a paper bag and the cartons leaked. The bag broke in my car, which is now going to need deep cleaning--although where that can be done these days, who knows?  The salvageable food was mediocre at best.  The chicken with mixed vegetables was particularly poor--the sauce was thick and almost slimy.  Beef with broccoli was ok.

We went for breakfast. Not good at all asked for over medium eggs. Eggs were hardly cooked at all. Had browns were to greasy and toast had a weird flavor. Should of sent it back but did not. Probably won't be back. Servers are nice though, their just not paying attention to ask how everything is. There are no decent restaurants in Ashland city at all.
This place was amazing, best lighting in town for pics! The food was amazing also. Try the salmon! It was so delish. Will definitely be back.
So although I got this To go the food is not very pleasant  the samosas are bland the wings taste like bbq sauce and not tandoori chicken and the Tiramasu tasted sour milk

Ohhh baby my breath was kicking but was it worth it!! I'm a huge fan of Mediterranean but my heart never leaves a appetizer platter. Every place does it a little differently and I was missing a few items I love but still..delicious! 4 different sauces to dip the pita bread in along with 4 falafels which are my favorite!

It's a newer place with simple decor but the staff is friendly and helpful. I was able to sit, enjoy my food, and work which was a nice break from my long drive. I would love to see this place grown and expand on the decor to make it look more Mediterranean! 

Either way great food which is all I wanted! Thanks for the bad breath worthy food

Today was my first time here and was very pleasantly surprised. My enchiladas were very delicious. I was starved when I arrived and when I got the chips and dip was also surprised - great salsa, chips and bean dip. Better than most you get at the average Mexican restaurant. Service was also quite good. Seating was COVID compliant and servers were masked and pleasant. Keep up the good work Barrigas!
So I decided to try mods pizza. I don't believe that ordering a pizza should be so involved.  I really hate this place. I hate it.  I felt like I had to join a gang just being there.  Look good?

These donuts are as good as they look!!  The Cronut and French Toast donut are ridiculous!!  We got a 1/2 dozen between the 3 of us and didn't finish one whole donut!  They are so big and sweet!!  It's the perfect treat on vacation!!  I would highly recommend going out of your way to eat here!
This is a great place for fresh food served with a smile. I had a Fruity Fran on a croissant with the Tomato Bisque soup! Delicious. Will go again.

We had dinner here on Friday night.  Excellent.  Invited another couple for dinner at this " excellent" place, and they totally embarrassed me. Arrived and got no service attention for 20 minutes.  Complained to hostess, waitress came and we had two minutes to make our dinner choices.  10 minutes later I went to hostess asking if we could at least have our wine.  Five minutes later, our appetizer, our salad AND our entire were all delivered, at ONCE.  Geez!  A conversation with the manager was a waste of time.  All I heard was "our computer ". I said as a customer , the computer is not my concern.  Platitudes from the Manager, AND poor waitress service.  A joke and I was embarrassed that I took people there.    I told the Manager that a not good review was coming, she didn't care.  Think twice.  Might be good, might be terrible.  Don't look to the staff to correct any issues.

I ordered their miso soup and fried rice and the miso soup was approximately two sips and the fried rice tasted like cardboard. I put yum yum sauce on the rice and it just tasted like wet spicy paper. It seemed like they seasoned it with pepper and that's it. Way overpriced for what I got.
Pizzas here are amazingly made with fresh veggies n handmade dough! And the beers they have is very refreshing! Anyone who prefer homemade pizza should definitely shop here...

I'm disappointed.. had high hopes based on the menu but unfortunately it failed and was pretty mediocre and the wines were not my favorite either . The customer service great however! The young boy who served us was truly nice and a great professional. This was supposed to be our anniversary dinner, I picked the spot and I feel horrible that we didn't go to our usual place loquita because both, my husband and I didn't enjoy it.

Saturday breakfast turned to brunch. I think with most places there tends to be a wait for a table that but wasn't my issue. Got to the restaurant about 11:30 and we were seated at 12. The waitress didn't come to the table until 12:25 which was 10 minutes after I asked the host about someone taking our order. The waitress came, said sorry for the wait, took our order and didn't return until nearly 20 minutes later when she put a messy syrup dispenser on the table. Meanwhile three tables that were seated after us were waited on and had their meals. We literally waited a half an hour for our food and the only reason I didn't leave was because my granddaughter was so hungry. 
The host was very pleasant and attentive but the waitress was inattentive and I couldn't see that she was overwhelmed more like uninterested. 
The food gets 5 stars but the service on that day gets 2.

First discovered this little diner with my boyfriend when we were looking for a place to get breakfast. My boyfriend and I love to explore different diners, and I must say Bonnet Lane is most definitely my favorite. We would always order their classic french toast and stuffed cream cheese french toast. Excellent quality food, at a very inexpensive price. Servers are very friendly as well. Whenever we end up in Abington, this is the go-to place!
Great food and great service. It was nice meeting Carly and it is fantastic to know that when you eat here you are supporting a locally owned family run business.

My experience was amazing !!!!! I loved the energy and Ian was great ! Best server i've ever had in my entire life. I literally wanted to give him all my money lol. If you go to the Sugar Factory in The Hard Rock Casino ask for Ian!

I had the carnitas, carne asada, and chicken tacos. They were all pretty good, the tortilla was the highlight. Of the 3, the carnitas was the best one but the other two were alright as well. 

I wouldn't say it's amazing, but if you need quick tacos, this is the place to go.
Awesome food great service always packed make sure to plan a little extra time for a drink while you're waiting, but well worth it
Just want to let all the truck drivers know that this location will not allow you to walk through the drive thru window. Very disappointing.

Our first time in Boise and found this little gem. Coming from Southern California and being around authentic Mexican food constantly we were of course not expecting much, just grabbing a quick bite. But let me tell you, this restaurant rivals any authentic Mexican restaurant and surpassed our expectations by far! The beans are out of the world and the asada is one of the best I have tasted. The salads are a great size with plenty of meat and veggies. Highly, highly recommend!!!!!

Got the Tandoori chicken with rice! Portions are large, food is delicious! I did take out order , it was quick and ready when I got there. First time ordering from there and definitely won't be the last

I came here for a casual Tuesday birthday dinner with a friend. We sat outside which was really nice and spacious. Perhaps this is a weird observation, but I felt far away from the other tables so there was a sense of privacy.

For food, my friend and I got a couple rolls to share. I'm vegan, so I can't really speak towards the freshness of the seafood or anything like that, but I was shocked at how good the veggie rolls I got were. I'm not a sushi connoisseur, but I think this is my new favorite sushi in Philly! The prices were reasonable as well - especially for how good the food was! I will definitely be back for happy hour soon!

This is not a fancy place but this is where the locals go eat seafood boils which you know it will be good. It's about a 10-15 min Uber/lyft drive from the main bourbon street area. It gets a 5 star because the quality and freshness from the seafood boil we ordered hit the spot. I've eaten at plenty of crawfish places in Seattle and this one was recommended to me by a NOLA local. You definitely want to get a reservation here or else you'll be waiting about an hour or more for dinner on a Friday night. Just to note - the pound of blue crab will mainly be the shells and small legs (it was a lot of work) but they do provide those crackers of course. We got the Cajun spice & medium hotness. It was filled with amazing flavor and it was the recommended flavor.
Hidden gem just off of Bourbon St. The freshest oysters, greatest service and friendly staff. They go the extra mile to make your visit special. You will love the vibe.

Lobster ramen is what I usually get here. I would like to try other bowls. However, I think they use the same broth for all ramen. Their drinks are very good. The strawberry mango smoothie is soo sooooo soooo good. Their milk tea are flavorful and their toppings are also good. Highly recommended for drinks and food at the same joint.
Really enjoyed the spinach salad and roasted Brussel sprouts. The service was very good. I would come here again.
I don't know why I even try coming to this place, horrible service and their ice cream machine is constantly broken.
Such a good breakfast spot, and I'm not even a biscuit person. Fast, friendly, efficient service on a warm Sunday morning. Proper distancing & PPE's. Nice outdoor seating.

"I suggest you tread very carefully."- Walter White (Breaking Bad)

Let me explain, extremely hit or miss here with the dishes. I was shocked when I saw Three flavor dumplings on the menu - nine dumplings, three chicken, three shrimp, three pork....sounds too good to be true right? 

The so called shrimp dumplings are definitely not shrimp and when I was asking the cashier if this really comes with three shrimp dumplings in it, she seemed hesistant to confirm and I think nodded. After trying the dish I can say I don't know what it is but I would never recommend anyone eat it. Two of the shrimp dumplings are showin the the picture attached on the far right. They are the dumplings that do not look like the others.

Moving right along...the Shrimp kung pao was quite good, let's give credit where credit is due. A spicy delicious sauce that is not overly sugarly and the shrimp were much better then the average shrimp from a chinese restaurant. 

When deciding when to order from here take into account the price is not bad compared to some other chinese take outs in the area but tread extremely carefully depending on how strong your stomach is and how brazen you want to be when ordering from the menu....would I order the chicken nuggets and the Pork Yat no...no..I would not.

I realize restaurants have no control COVID regulations,  but it is frustrating to go to your restaurant and to be RUDELY told, "you need a reservation."   We frequently dine at Gold Dust West and usually have a good experience.

This place deserves 5 stars for so many reasons!! Live music, awesome venue, 50 on tap beers. However, my main reason behind this review is Melissa. Melissa served my parents and I while on vacation. We had picked a seat and my mom had decided she was too hot to sit there. We asked Melissa if we could move and she did not mind at all. She served us drinks, asked us our names and introduced herself. A few drinks in, I was freezing under the fan and eventually decided to move back. Melissa was so unbelievably kind about it and was not bothered what so ever! I appreciated how personable and kind she was, even when as a group we're difficult. She was kind and had great conversation. Drinks were awesome and service was top notch. WILL COME AGAIN!
Have not been  here in 20 years. I was happy to see it  still in business. Good food and delicious pastries. friendly staff. Hope I'm back in  NOLA before another 20 years pass.

I'm obsessed with King Dough.  The pizza is classic wood-oven Italian style with a thin, chewy crust, lots of charring, and those magical crust-bubbles that are the mark of real pizza.  Topping builds range from classic to inventive, with lots of gourmet options if you're into that.  Me, I'm into pepperoni and cheese most of the time, and they make that to perfection.  Also gotta mention the amazing wings, especially the firecracker - they pack a Sezchuan peppercorn punch that rocks my world.  King Dough also has an impeccable bar and an expertly curated wine selection.  Service is swift and amazing too!  Get on it!

Locally sourced. I live that. Vegan and vegi options. It's a really cool shack that I stopped by in the evening and I was impressed. I ordered a medium rare but I don't feel like it was all that juicy. That is my only complaint.
My husband and I ordered the garlic knots and a bacon/pepperoni pizza. Everything was really good, but a little pricey for what you get.

Great beer selection, great burgers and best damn fries in the NE, the price is good.
I leave close so I like to stop in grab s burger and fries and walk around corner to my porch and eat,, it's a spot to check out for sure ..

I was underwhelmed.  The menu was decent.  I ordered an asada chimi with rice.  I should have mentioned "no sour cream" since apparently they put it on their chimis.

The chimi was cooked well.  A light crispy shell.  The asada was adequate.  Didn't really excite me.  I'm aware that genuine Mexican food is simple.  But the asada  was almost tasteless, which isn't a characteristic of Mexican food.  Well, perhaps that is an overstatement.  But it wasn't as flavorful as it should have been.  The red sauce was pretty good.  The rice was very flavorful, which was nice.

Overall I would say an average performance.  Not great, not bad.  You could do worse, but you also could do better.
Food ok, customer service poor. Employees seem very miserable like their pet cat died . No smile , no expressions , no greeting , no thank you , nothing diddly squat .

Monell's tops our list! Fun! Delicious! Beautiful! Friendly! 
Be prepared-it is family style. Don't have a family; don't worry; you will! They will sit smaller parties together and that's where the fun begins! We met our "family" when they sat down after their trip to Italy. We just finished our trip to Nashville. The 3 of us and the 4 of them had a blast!! We laughed and ate and the ate and laughed some more.
Oh, you want to know about the food-well, OK. A LOT!! YUMMY! They start you off with salads-we had cole slaw and cucumber salad. I could have eaten a vat of that cucumber salad. Then once our family was situated, they bring the mac and cheese, the beef stew, the fried chicken, the potatoes, and the rest of the YUM! They will bring you more when plates of food are empty. Dessert was banana pudding. 
If you leave there hungry-it is your own fault. Hard to leave there without a bunch of new friends too.
We have since recommended and talked about Monell's to anyone that will listen.
Oh, get there early; they do not take reservations. This is the location near the airport. They have another one in Germantown.

Meril came highly recommended and I went there with 3 other people, all of whom travel often for business and eat out at all types of dining establishments.  I was in NOLA for 6 days and tried about 12 different places and unfortunately, Meril was nowhere near the top.  We expected more, especially because it's the namesake of the 2nd most popular celebrity chef (after Paul Prudhomme) in this city.  I will state that the restaurant and it's atmosphere were amazing.  There was a great energy and everyone was having a great time.  Service was a group effort and went basically flawless.  We didn't have a celebration, but it was cool to see them sending cotton candy as a unique party option.  We were actually sitting right beside the machine that was in front of a very clean open kitchen.  I highly recommend everything, but the only setback was food, which was the main reason we went there.  Now I'm allergic to shellfish, so I can only go by what my table mates had to say.  We started with the Korean fried chicken wings.  They were served lollipop style and looked amazing.  They serve 3, but they added an additional on to our order so we could each have one.  I was expecting a sticky sweetness with a spicy after kick.  There was a little flavor at the start and then it just disappeared immediately with no afterburn.  The fried buttermilk biscuits were good, but I barely remembered them (had to look up the menu again).  The flatbreads looked amazing, but they ran out of the one we

We stopped by because we saw the reviews and were excited to try it. Luckily, it was happy hour when we got there and were able to choose where we wanted to sit outdoors. The staff was nice. We ordered the sopecitos yucatecos, tostadita de ceviche verde, and taco culichi, for drinks modelo especial, spicy cucumber margarita and Paloma clásica. The food was good, different from what I've had before. What I did not enjoy were the mixed drinks. I asked the waiter if I could switch my spicy cucumber margarita for the Paloma clásica because I didn't like, but was shocked that the Paloma clásica wasn't good either. They both tasted bland. Difficult to explain how they were missing flavor.
Phenomenal coffee in a beautiful space. Tall ceilings, exposed brick. Friendly, knowledgeable staff. Obsessed with their frozen cafe au lait!

I know this place is a chain but they never disappoint with unique, delicious food. Even if you are not an okra fan, you might like their seasonal appetizer of broiled/blistered okra. I always fine a lot of vegetarian options. I just wish there were Tupelo Honey restaurants above the Mason-Dixon line.

We were looking for something local, not a chain restaurant, in the vicinity of our new townhome in Hermitage. As we were driving we spotted what at first we thought was Panera, but saw it it said Panini, in a smaller strip mall off of Stewart's Ferry Pike. We pulled in, and were glad we did.

My wife had the Chicken Salad, and I had the Buffalo Chicken Panini. They were both delicious.

Freshly made and toasted, the gentleman used fresh ingredients to make some of the best paninis I've had in a long time. We had the option of 4 bread types, (white, wheat, tomato and spinach). I had the tomato on the buffalo and my wife had spinach on hers. Great choices though I think any of the four would have been good.

We wish we had time to order the fresh made bread loaves. The fresh deserts looked good, too.

Prices were very reasonable, ($7.25/panini) and a small bag of chips were part of the deal.

We will be coming back!

When we want Chinese and want to enjoy a night in. We order China Dragon. It's your typical Chinese delivery, they have never gotten my order wrong and are always here within the time period they gave me. So kudos for consistency and delivery. 

My husband loves their egg rolls and I am obsessed with their crab Rangoon. It's sweet yet savory and always full of filling. No skimpy crap around here ha! We get different entrees every time but my husband and I do enjoy the shrimp fried rice! Nonetheless I've never been unsatisfied and always had left overs!

My boyfriend and I both had mushroom paprikas, it was very good. I just had some leftovers and honestly, in that time the spaetzle marinaded nicely in the sauce bringing it to a 5-star flavor. The dessert menu looked increds, though we didn't have room to find out. The beverage selection was sparse. The service was great.

Literally the worst customer service i have ever experienced. The woman who works in the drive thru is utterly disrespectful and rude. My food came out wrong also. Nothing about this place is worth my money.

If i could give this place no stars I would. Ordered a bacon king and got a cheeseburger with piece of bacon. Took it back and was told i Ordered a a junior burger. I threw it in the trash because it looked disgusting.

This place is bomb  
Highly recommend ! If you are craving fried chicken , order from here.
Im from Long Beach, CA where Roscoe's is a big deal so of course I ordered the chicken and waffles to see how they compare.
Definitely exceeded my expectations  
Plus staff was very friendly 
COVID guidelines in place and hand sanitizer available
We went to lunch here today for the first time. We had chicken wings, a salad,and a burger. We loved it! Everything was so good and fresh. We can't wait to go back and try the pizza!

3 or 4 max, for mediocre "typical" pizza joint food (wings, mozz. sticks, salads with iceberg lettuce, chicken parm) and often super crowded.  People just LOVE it here and it has been a Media, PA institution.  Plus they have a ton of beer - so thus, the crowds.

It is the best ever?  No.  But it is a solid choice for couples, singles and families with kids (and yes, there are alot of those) to grab a mid-priced pizza-joint meal.

The pizza itself is fine.  Not a holy grail and not bad - the Sicilian is great if you are willing to wait for it. Do not be in a rush and then order a Sicilian pie.

An absolutely awful experience, terrible management and staff. Went in to this location and nobody was inside or at the counter. I waited for about 5 minutes at the counter to place my order. Then a young man came out and said he was going to be a few more minutes but if I wanted to place an order to use the electronic menu behind me. I looked and I realized I was paying with cash so I couldn't use it. Waited another 15 minutes for him to return without any apologies for the wait. Very rude!!  Again nobody is in the store He took my order they were focused on drive thru only. Then after another 5 minutes he brings my order out and calls my name and leaves It on the counter. I was appalled at the mannerism. Then I went to get some  sauce, napkins, a straw etc. and they were all empty as well as there was trash all over the floor and some on the tables. I sit down to eat and my order was not what I paid for. I took it up and said I ordered soft taco supremes and he asked for my receipt, then looks at it and says "My Bad" no apology, nothing. Takes it back and another guy brings it out and just tosses it on the counter. Ridiculous!!! My order was small, 3 soft taco supremes and it took me 35 minutes to get out of there without any napkins to wipe my hands clean either. The worst service. My time is valuable and this was unbelievable. They need new management and staff needs training on manners or they shouldn't have a job.

Hit or miss with this place. 

We moved here from out of state in January, and found what we thought was a true little gem! Unfortunately the 3rd time we were there, we had horrible service. Wasn't checked in on at all, and it just wasn't that appetizing. But we figured it was because of Valentine's Day. 

Well, next visit, we were seated and had no server come to us even after 10 minutes. Needless to say- we walked out. 

They previously reopened from COVID and we went in- which had better service, but after eating we didn't feel that great. 


We miss our blue haired waitress when we first started coming here.
This place is always out of something, like burgers or fries..on one visit at 2 pm on a Tuesday they said the were temporarily closed so they could clean their grills. Way to do a company proud!

Awesome food, this is one of my favorite vegan take out style places to eat and delivery was great. Left in lobby as instructed.

Requested update: For a first timer I'd strongly recommend the sweet potato fries (absolutely the best) with the house sauce. As an entree the classic burger here is great, I myself am more of a salad person my favorite here is their taco salad.

May I suggest: 

One of my favorite restaurants in St. Pete and one of my favorites for Italian. What I usually like to get when I come here is one of their pasta dishes and I pair it with a small version of their misticanza salad (spring mix, tomatoes, onions, and greek olives all mixed in a light vinagrette). Its light and refreshing, but I always get gorgonzila cheese added for a little extra bite. When it comes to the pasta, I typically go with either lobster mac n cheese or the pasta brava. What I love about their lobster mac n cheese is that its lighter on the cheese sauce and you can taste the lobster in every bite. The truffled bread crumbs give it a nice touch. My other choice would be their pasta brava, which is more or less their version of pasta carbonara, but better.

Food was good, I'm giving this place a 3 bc of the lack of hot sauces... prior pictures showed various hot sauces yet now just 2 and they were both not spicy..

I think all good taco places need lots of variation of hot sauces not just 2 mild sauces... 

I'm a hot sauce person so this was highly disappointing..
I even asked for some of their aiolis and those weren't hot either

They're new. People need to give them a break. I've had service in the bar 3 times now and it was fantastic. The main restaurant seating wasn't as good, but they were significantly more busy. The margaritas are delicious... I do think they need to add pitchers of margaritas their menu.

This is my go to spot for a nice drink with friends! They have a pretty good selection of beer! The wings though I do not feel are worth the money here! Extremely small wings for a high price! Burgers are ok, not too much flavor going on here at this hooters. But like I said this is mostly a drinking spot for me. I gave the food a shot a couple of times and just never really liked it! But the staff is pretty cool and it's a nice place to watch the game! Also a big plus that they have outdoor smoking seating! If the food was better and the wings larger this would be a five star for me!

Food was absolutely some of the best I have had anytime recently. We had Bruschetta, chicken parm and chicken Marsala and each one was spot on. Keep up the great Italian  cooking!!!  Sorry we didn't get to try any pizza!

This place just might be the best kept secret in Tampa.  At 6:30 on a Friday night, we were one of two tables taken in the restaurant.  I think that's mainly due to the location, but don't be fooled.  Their happy hour is awesome...$2 Imported Beers.  Soho roll was on the happy hour menu as well, and it was delicious.  Tuna Avocado / Salmon Avocado Rolls are great.  Solid customer service as well.  Check out Sushi Avenue!

Sadly to say my last visit didn't go well. Ordered food that was suppose to be vegan and ended up getting shrimp and i got sick for two days. I decided to come back today. Feb 9th and ordered food that was once again...lined with raw fish. This time I will take some responsibility for it because I didn't speak directly with the chef but with the host who translated my request for FISH free food.

My husband and I visited Gus's World Famous Fried Chicken in New Orleans for the first time last night  9-9-20. The food was excellent the chicken was hot , fresh and juicy. We ordered a side of okra very fresh not little hard pre-frozen rocks like some places. This okra was plump and tender and lightly battered. To end the meal with desert we shared the homemade sweet potato pie delicious. The environment was lovely we ate inside seating were distant apart and staff had mask and gloves. Very friendly waiter and waitress two people checked on us. It was a $40.00 date night which covered the cost of 2 meals , one side, desert, drinks (tea & beer) plus a tip. We will go again.
If you are looking for a less busy breakfast establishment in NOLA, then this place is an idea. The food was fine overall.

We called ahead since we had 5 people in our party and they told us we were on the wait and it would be 20mins. So we showed up and they said we don't do call ahead so that was weird. But they sat us anyways. 
It's  hot upstairs and the light shined in our faces so we put menus up to kind of block it. So hold on to menus! 
It took a little to get seen so they might be understaffed. Water was given and needed. 
Once getting service it was good. I wouldn't do the water Fresca or the mock-tail we got ever again. The mock-tail was Pepto-Bismol and started to curtal. The watermelon Fresca you couldn't really taste the flavor. 
The breakfast sandwiches we got were great, BLt, Cuban and Popeye. The meatballs stuffed spaghetti won over my kid but that's about it. It was lack luster. 
I feel like it's mostly kitschy. I will say the supernova cocktail was great as well.
This place is absolutely amazing the food is so flavorful, and the owner is such a delight. I would love to come back and when I do I will try everything else I missed out on.

Gracious, friendly service!

Our party of 10 enjoyed a business dinner that ran almost to their closing time, and they did a great job of allowing us to feel unrushed in our own corner of the restaurant.

Views are STUNNING! The restaurant, itself, could use a bit of freshening/updating. Food was good - not spectacular, but not bad either. We ordered plenty of cocktails, appetizers, and main courses, and I didn't hear any complaints.

Great place for a large group to enjoy the best views in Santa Barbara!

Seemed like a sketchy place from the name, outside, but man the pizza was delicious! And SO cheap! We were shocked by the prices, honestly, and even more so when we tasted how good the pizza was. Don't get the garlic knots. They were disappointing. Super small, with very little seasoning. They were saved by pouring the garlic sauce on them, but even then they were just fine.

Small portions for the lunch special. The food did not fast fresh, and there were hardly any vegetables or meat in the dish. The fried rice tasted stale. Again, no veggies just rice with soy sauce. The egg roll was thin like a footsie roll, no filling at all. Only eat here if you like bland , not fresh uninspiring food.

If i could give zero stars i would. Gave me freezer burnt sandwiches and a melted donut and when i came back to ask for a refund the manager on shift wanted to argue with me saying the bagels were fresh and they're fine and kept insisting that they remake my food and not refund me and then asked for me receipt and that was the only way they can refund me (not true i've worked at dunkin my self) and when i stayed well the girl didn't give me a receipt she wanted to argue and say it's my fault i didn't get one... i would've been happier flushing $15 down the toilet  then spend it at that dunkin again... smh. get it together people.

I was extremely excited when this place opened as I've been driving to Manila Cafe in Mount Laurel NJ. I hated that my family and I were disappointed. The lumpia was very empty of meat and the flavor wasn't that good. The adobo was ok but nothing exciting. Alas I'm am driving an hour to NJ.

This is one of the worst I've ever seen. After sitting in drive-thru for ten minutes, she finally comes on the speaker and says, very rudely, " I need a minute!" It's been five minutes and she hasn't come back. If it wasn't the only place open, I'd have left a long time ago, but I'm hungry. Ok, five more minutes and NOTHING. Horrible service! Steak 'N Shake, you should be ashamed! I'm leaving!!!!! Don't come here!
Love this place. Amazing fresh pasta, pre-made meals and to die for bakery. Also, lots of imported gourmet foods and cheeses. Expect a crowd and be patient with the lines. They move fast.
Amazing Mexican - speedy service - unique choices - fun environment!!!!  Our church small groups love  to go hear because it family friendly, has great food and simply delicious

Had my first experience here with my client! Vicky was a pleasure to have as a server! She was very friendly and courteous with my client and it was really amaizng!  Definitely will be back with my family and friends!

The only thing better than the food at Heidelberg is the service. 
The ladies that serve the meals and wrap the bakery treats are always very friendly. They are quick to help if I have a question about certain German items in the store. You can't go wrong with the spicy sausage, authentic German potato salad, and European rye bread and of course an apple pastry.
Nice selection and good portions for the price.  Salmon tasted fresh.  Staff is nice and efficient.  About 2 miles off I75 but worth the drive
Chipolte Chicken Sandwich... is amazing. Picklemans never disappoints!! I live in a different state now and make it a point to have picklemans every time I'm home!!
Always the best! Fish is so good... served hot with plenty of fries. Friendly service  The antipasto as an appetizer was such a nice touch! This is my go to place for fish!!!

The owner was an incredible host which made the experience so meaningful. Wonderful hospitality and the Guisado was great. I paired it with fried plantains which was more than enough food (even for two). Will definitely come back. Also try the blackberry and yellowberry juice!

Came for breakfast and sat outside on the patio. Our server was very friendly. Had the strawberry shortcake French toast, side of potatoes, and bacon. All were excellent. Great price for the quality. I will be back and will recommend to friends and family.

My fiancé and I visited Nashville in August and had a TERRIBLE experience with a local AirBNB. Once we checked out, we were really hoping for Nashville to redeem itself and Saint Angelo really came through! 

Server Claire and Manager Scott were the most gracious of hosts, taking care of our meal as a way of apologizing for the AirBNB experience even though they had no hand in the situation. 

Best of all, the burrito we shared and the Bloody Maria's were AMAZING! The food was clearly made with fresh ingredients and the drinks were unique and everything was very well priced. 

FYI - Everyone was very COVID safe with masks, distancing, etc.

I wanted to give this place a 5 star rating BUT the service is super slow and we found hair in our food not the end of the word until the staff tried to play it off like it was a thyme stem. I may try them again but I'm not sure yet

I walked out of this twice now. Not usually my style but they consistently provide terrible service. We were seated and then forgotten. We waited about 20 minutes before anyone even touched our table. I've had the food a while ago and it was good but I don't spend my money where my presence isn't valued.

Always delicious! I appreciate that I can always find more than one dish that is both gluten free and vegan. The portions are always more than generous, to boot. Honestly I could eat here every day of the week!

Came here for dinner on a Saturday night and had a great experience! Our party of four ordered the eggplant rollatini to share and really liked it. Our waitress also brought out complimentary carrots (unique flavor, served cold) and bruschetta for the table which we also really liked. My husband fans I both ordered the seafood pasta - one with the pesto sauce and one with the rose sauce. They were both really good but the blush sauce is definitely what wowed us most! The place is also BYOB which is obviously a great plus but they do have a small bar themselves. It looks like they have two private rooms for private parties too. Would definitely come back!
Love this place! Food  is alwAys fresh, chicken pita special on Tuesday is great. Employees- charlie and kenny are fantastic always gets  my order fast and accurate.
Best buffet so far on the westbank we have been looking since moving here and a decent price. Kids love the decor as well

I'm often on the lookout for quick meals, and I won't stand for food that's merely functional. There's no reason a low-brow meal can't be delicious and totally enjoyable and, in most cases, in a pleasant setting with friendly vibes. Appetite Global Cuisine is a charming restaurant that offers value and is perfect for your next date night or dinner with parents.

The atmosphere is warm and inviting, and the friendly service is knowledgeable and efficient. And above all, the food is excellent and it's very reasonably priced. You really can't go wrong here. For something tasty and Italian, their seafood linguine is packed full of flavor and they use as many fresh ingredients as possible. The Moroccan beef kebabs were perfectly seasoned and tasted amazing with the couscous. For the price point and the quality of the ingredients they use, it's hard to beat Appetite Global Cuisine. Where else can you have enjoy Italian linguine, Austrian schnitzel, Korean BBQ ribs and Moroccan kefta all at the same restaurant?  

What's also awesome about them are the great people who run the restaurant.  Chef Reggie has an impressive career spanning Asia, Switzerland,Germany, Belgium, Montreal and Edmonton with previous work experiences that include working for 5 star hotels and was the former Executive Chef of Chateau Lacombe. His Swiss trained culinary background definitely shows in the selection and quality of dishes here. 

Everything is made from scratch and if you have gluten sensitivities,

Note, THIS IS ABOUT CUSTOMER SERVICE AND NOT FOOD!

Dropped in after finding this place on yelp, I was super excited to try their huevos rancheros. We were ask if we had a reservation, we said no and asked about the wait. The hostess did not know how long the wait was, she seemed a bit lost.  But she also just told us that the bar was full. It just felt that there was no attempt to make us feel welcomed or to accommodate drop ins. If this is a reservation only restaurant, it should be made clear! It was busy but not extremely busy, three tables were empty and granted these could be for reservations. I did not like the way we were treated, she could have been nicer to us and apologetic but she didn't seem to care.

I had experience a lady that was racist towards me when me and my husband was told to be seated and wait for our food to go. For some reason she told me that I was not 6 ft. Apart from her when she wasn't even there. Come on lady who was the one that was not 6ft. Apart. I was sitting there mining my own business waiting for my food. Thank you for the management and worker who witness this and appreciate to put me away from this racist lady. Workers are all professionals food is great.

The typical Australian feast as always. Well seasoned steak, hearty potatoe, and great bread. I usually have no complaints with the food. Thisnlication was making people wait 30 min for a table, when 75 percent of the tables were empty because they were short staffed. I was really turned off because we used the app for check.in seating. The app told us 25 minutes and we got there in 20 minutes and they quoted us an additional 30 minute wait. What's the point of using the call ahead seating if they're not going to honor it.
